subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom that can be substituted in the following sentence.**

He **__burnt his fingers__** interfering in others’ problems.
solution:
The correct answer is **"got into trouble."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"burnt his fingers" **means to suffer negative consequences or get into trouble. (नकारात्मक परिणाम भुगतना या मुसीबत में पड़ना)

 
 
• Example: *She'd invested extensively in stocks and **burnt her fingers**__ when the market collapsed.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the person faced problems by interfering in others' matters.
 
• The usage of **"burnt his fingers"** is figurative and not literal.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
